# Patrol survival

Used in [Combat](/rules/60-combat).

| | |
|---|---|
| **Recce only modifier** | -1 |

## Table

| Die | Killed | Captured |
|---|---|---|
| 0–3 | 0 | 0 |
| 4 | 0 | 1 |
| 5 | 1 | 0 |
| 6 | 1 | 1 |

## Notes

- One die per patrol (skipped when the target hex holds no combat units, SPI 16.5x): TOE points of the patrolling force killed / captured. Subtract one from the die when every patrolling point is recce (recce_only_modifier), which is why a 0 row exists
- Transcribed from the archive.org scan (jp2 95) and cross-checked against the 300 dpi community scan of the chart sheet (scan:discord:Shared Charts.pdf:p1): 0 of 8 cells differ. Clay Stone's errata-integrated Land rules PDF contains no chart sheet
